name: Lesson 4 · Face tricks
intro: Snaps, cutbacks and slides score without leaving the wave.

goals.hint: Turns are not buttons here. Lean both sticks toward the wave and hold it — the harder the lean, the bigger the turn
goals.hintClassic: Double-tap a stick direction with J (X) held: up-up snaps off the lip, down-down cuts back

goals.hint: Where you turn decides what it is called: down the bottom is a bottom turn, up at the lip is a snap, away from the wave is a cutback
goals.hintClassic: Vary the tricks: repeating one is worth less each time
